rdfs:label: Application
rdfs:comment: An ActivityStreams actor that is a software application — a client app or bot acting under its own identity.
notes: One of the AS actor types alongside `as:Person`, `as:Group`, `as:Organization`, `as:Service`. Use for non-human actors that are software (clients, bots, automation). For PROV-grade software-agent attribution, see `prov:SoftwareAgent`. AS2 defines Application as "a software application" and Service as "a service of any kind"; Mastodon marks bot accounts as `Service`, so choosing between the two is convention, not semantics.

history.note: Narrowed comment to software applications; added Service to notToBeConfusedWith; seeAlso uses urn:solid:Service; noted Mastodon's Service-for-bots convention.
